name: Backpack, Straw
body:
Straw Backpack: This backpack is little more than a woven straw basket with shoulder straps. The pack holds 2 cubic feet worth of material, but it cannot hold more than 20 lbs. worth of material without breaking. The pack is naturally extremely flammable. Cost 2 cp.
